title: IAM Engineer
description: Design and manage enterprise identity and access management solutions, Zero Trust principles, Single Sign-On (SSO), SAML, OAuth 2.0, and Okta.

goal.objective: Secure organizational identities, implement frictionless single sign-on, and enforce least-privilege role-based access across enterprise applications.
career_pillars: Cloud Identity Providers (Okta, Entra ID, Ping)

learn.summary: Master authentication protocols (SAML 2.0, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect), Okta/Entra ID directory architecture, Privileged Access Management (CyberArk), and SCIM provisioning.
prerequisites: Familiarity with corporate IT and directories

capstone_projects.title: Centralized OIDC/SAML2 Enterprise Single Sign-On & SCIM Gateway
capstone_projects.description: Deploy an enterprise identity provider supporting SAML 2.0 and OIDC federation, passwordless WebAuthn MFA, and automated user provisioning via SCIM 2.0.

capstone_projects.title: Automated Just-In-Time (JIT) Cloud Privileged Access Management Engine
capstone_projects.description: Engineer a self-service JIT access workflow in Slack allowing developers to request temporary elevated cloud permissions with manager approvals and immutable audit trails.

certifications: Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate (SC-300)
interview_focus: OAuth2.0 vs OIDC vs SAML 2.0 Protocol Handshakes & Assertion Tokens
Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) vs Attribute-Based Access Control (ABAC)
Principle of Least Privilege & Cloud IAM Evaluation Logic (Explicit Deny, SCPs, Boundary Policies)
Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) Protocols, FIDO2/WebAuthn & Phishing-Resistant Credentials
Automated User Lifecycle Management (SCIM Protocol, JIT Provisioning & Deprovisioning)
